source:
@@U03059@@
The question is, how does this man recover? If you have a remedy, test it here; but if you can't, leave it to me.

@@U03061@@
I could try out some of my 布罗肯山 tricks, except for the heathenish bolts blocking the gate. Those Greeks were never good for much. They dazzle you with the free play of the senses, luring men’s hearts into a colorful kind of sinning; and what is ours, our sinning, but a morass of gloom? So what do we do now?

@@U03063@@
Considering you were never shy, if I say Thessalian witches you'd know what I mean.

@@U03065@@
(Lecherously.)

@@U03066@@
Thessalian witches! Yes, well! That’s a different story! I’ve been curious about them for quite some time. Night after night, of course, might be less than a pleasure. But a visit? What's there to lose?

@@U03068@@
Bring your cloak and wrap it around our knight. As before, it will carry the two of you. I'll light the way.

@@U03070@@
(Anxiously.)

@@U03071@@
And what about me?

@@U03073@@
You, 瓦格纳? Well, you'll be staying home; you have important things to do. Perusing your ancient parchments, you must do as they instruct;
translation:
@@U03059@@
问题是，这个人是如何康复的呢？如果你有补救办法，请在这里测试一下；但如果你做不到，那就交给我吧。

@@U03061@@
我可以尝试一些我的布罗肯山技巧，除了挡住大门的异教徒螺栓。那些希腊人从来都没有什么用处。它们以感官的自由发挥让你眼花缭乱，引诱人心陷入丰富多彩的罪恶；我们的罪，我们的罪，不就是一片阴暗的沼泽吗？那么我们现在该怎么办？

@@U03063@@
考虑到你从不害羞，如果我说色萨利女巫，你就会明白我的意思。

@@U03065@@
（好色的。）

@@U03066@@
色萨利女巫！是的，好吧！那是一个不同的故事！我对它们感到好奇已经有一段时间了。当然，一夜又一夜可能并不令人愉快。但拜访？有什么可失去的呢？

@@U03068@@
带上你的斗篷，把它裹在我们的骑士身上。和以前一样，它将承载你们两个。我会照亮道路。

@@U03070@@
（焦急地。）

@@U03071@@
那我呢？

@@U03073@@
你，瓦格纳？好吧，你会呆在家里；你有重要的事情要做。仔细阅读你古老的羊皮纸，你必须按照它们的指示去做；
